title: SCARIEST MOD EVER!!!
description: a parody horror mod that adds dumb entities and structures
body:
## WARNING!
⚠ THE MOD MAY CONTAIN FLASHING IMAGES (unintentionally), LOUD SOUNDS (press M for stopping them in case it gets too wild), AND VISUALS TOO SCARY FOR THE NORMAL EYE.....



# HELLO!
This MCreator-made mod was a parody of horror minecraft mods (or even just one mod.. [ahem](https://modrinth.com/mod/evil-hunter)) that don't do a good job at scaring you, but it has grown into something a little different. The mod itself is not really that scary but more of a challenging mod knowing how dangerous some of the entities are.
The mod currently doesn't have a lot of content, but it will update as i get more ideas.
(also just to clarify, the mod doesn't have any lore.)

# Contents

The mod currently has 4 entities, 5 items, a whole bunch of structures and a new dimension.
**You can learn more about them on the wiki page!**

![all of the items and blocks added in one place](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5661c8c8d318913163c1b184c16d1215be1a6362.png)

![all of the entities in a scary little dimension..](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4b5e7a823abffe6e21a62de189767a9387aa9257.png)
